purpose: Form DIR-9 is used by a company to inform the Registrar about director disqualifications or company defaults specified under section 164.
when: Within thirty days of receiving Form DIR-8, or immediately upon company failure to file financial statements/annual returns or repay deposits, interest, dividends, or redeem debentures.
steps: Receive Form DIR-8 from the director.
Prepare Form DIR-9 furnishing the names and addresses of all directors during the relevant financial years.
File Form DIR-9 with the Registrar within thirty days of receiving Form DIR-8 or immediately upon company default.
checklist: Information from the director in Form DIR-8
Names of all directors of the company during the relevant financial years
Addresses of all directors of the company during the relevant financial years
watch: Failure to file Form DIR-9 within thirty days of the failure attracting disqualification makes the specified officers the officers in default.
